question: Which edition of the Joint Military Exercise Ekuverin was conducted between India and the Maldives in December 2025, and where was it conducted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14th edition, Thiruvananthapuram (Kerala).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The 14th edition of the India–Maldives Joint Military Exercise Ekuverin commenced in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The exercise is being conducted from December 2 to 15, 2025.**
 
• **Indian Army contingent includes 45 personnel from a battalion of the Garhwal Rifles.**
 
• **Maldives National Defence Force (MNDF) is participating with a contingent of equal strength.**
 
• **Exercise location: Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, reflecting India's Neighborhood First policy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Exercise Ekuverin**__

 __
 
• Started in 2009 and held alternately in India and the Maldives.
 
• “Ekuverin” means “friend” in Dhivehi, symbolizing strong India–Maldives ties.
 
• Focuses on counter-insurgency and counter-terrorism in jungle, semi-urban and coastal terrain.
 
 
 
• **Garhwal Rifles**__
 __
 
• A distinguished infantry regiment of the Indian Army.
 
• Known for its operational excellence in diverse terrains.
 
 
 
• **MNDF (Maldives National Defence Force)**__
 __
 
• Responsible for defence and security of the Maldives.
 
• Actively participates in regional security cooperation with India.
 
 
 
• **Neighborhood First Policy**__
 
 
• India’s diplomatic initiative to strengthen ties with neighbouring countries.
 
• Prioritises defence, economic and regional stability partnerships.
